milestones.title: Public profile boundary
milestones.objective: Make pp-leads-brasil independent of private profiles while retaining explicit external profile configuration.

stories.title: Remove implicit profile discovery and isolate public fixtures
dod: The public CLI no longer scans for or exports an OrganizeJr default profile.
Public tests run without the private sibling checkout or a private lead table.
Explicit PP_LEADS_USE_CASE_CONFIG and PP_LEADS_ICP_DIR profile loading remains covered by tests.
Doctor reports explicit profile state without implicit discovery.
Public architecture and data-flow documentation no longer describe private CRM operations.
Scrape Creators is always attempted for social enrichment; Apify runs as a configured, non-blocking fallback when the primary provider fails.
Graphify is updated after source changes and canonical context records validation evidence.
evidence: go test ./... passed: 3 packages ok, 4 packages with no tests
TestRunEnrichFallsBackToApifyWhenScrapeCreatorsFails verifies provider ordering and the non-blocking Apify fallback
public source search found no OrganizeJr default-profile discovery or PP_LEADS_ICP_DIR injection
graphify update . completed AST extraction for 721 files and rebuilt the structural report

milestones.title: External-operation contract
milestones.objective: Allow explicit private profiles to apply bounded external mutations through persisted plans, explicit approval and per-target receipts.

stories.title: Introduce generic external operation plans
dod: Planning is side-effect free and persists an immutable, expiring target diff.
Apply requires a stored plan ID and explicit approval; --agent is insufficient authorization.
Each target produces an idempotent receipt with evidence and before/after values.
Adapter failures are partial and visible without replaying completed targets.
No provider or profile-specific adapter is embedded in the public platform.
evidence: Operation plans persist canonical SHA-256 digests, expiry and ordered target diffs in profile-owned storage
Operation application requires approval, records per-target receipts and is idempotent for successful targets
CLI operation apply rejects --agent-only invocation; explicit --yes is required
go test ./... and leads-brasil-pp-cli go test ./... passed

milestones.title: Audited CRM synchronization
milestones.objective: Let an explicit private profile synchronize approved, field-level Google Sheets to Ploomes changes through the m21 plan and receipt contract.

stories.title: Plan, apply and reconcile explicit CRM field changes
dod: The private adapter validates schema, row lock, immutable identity, Ploomes ID and before value before mutation.
Plans contain only explicitly selected field-level targets with private evidence references.
Apply uses the m21 approval and receipt contract; successful targets are idempotent.
Each applied target is reconciled with read-only Google Sheets and Ploomes reads.
Public source and tests remain free of private CRM material.
evidence: Public generic CommandAdapter invokes only a profile-declared executable with the stored target JSON on stdin
Private OrganizeJr schema, explicit snapshot plan builder and fail-closed Ploomes adapter were added
go test ./... and CLI tests passed; private scripts compiled and schema validation passed
